values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Require every release claim to bind exact implementation, validation, review, merge, terminal receipt, artifact hash, risk, and non-claim evidence.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('.csdlc/evidence/5852/release-evidence-manifest.json')); abort 'empty manifest' unless r['rows'].is_a?(Array) && !r['rows'].empty?; abort 'unbound claim' unless r['rows'].all? { |x| %w[claim implementation_ref validation_ref review_ref merge_sha terminal_ref].all? { |k| x[k] } }

lanes.proof_role: Prove tag/release ordering, identity checks, dry-run behavior, partial-failure recovery, and duplicate-mutation rejection.
Reject red checks, active claims, missing receipts/findings, dirty head, tag/release conflict, partial verification, stale assets, and blind retries.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('.csdlc/evidence/5852/ceremony-negative-cases.json')); abort 'negative case escaped' unless r['cases'].is_a?(Array) && r['cases'].all? { |x| x['outcome']=='blocked' }

lanes.proof_role: Validate final notes, plan, checklist, handoff, links, hashes, redaction, claims, and diff hygiene without broad product tests.
Validate the exact rendered six-card bundle, cross-card references, digests, statuses, and canonical issue record.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on false completion claims, path collisions, invalid lifecycle state, or missing named proof; preserve a specific blocker instead of degrading.
